result.reason: The grant appropriately covers affiliates and contractors and purports to permit transfer to an M&A successor, while retaining the Authorized Locations and fee limitations. However, clauses (c) and (d) still require Garman’s consent for any transfer or assignment, directly conflicting with the new successor-transfer right. The clause also does not address perpetual, irrevocable paid-up licences or limit termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. The margin comment does not cure these operative omissions and inconsistencies.
